description:
## Goal

Repair the draft stack so every pull request, branch, commit, and closed ticket name the same atomic change before fz-5xp.30 is reworked. The current #148 misleadingly contains fz-5xp.30, fz-kdt.22, and fz-tfn.67 while its title/body describe only .30.

## Verified starting state

#148 currently has exact ancestry `b3204097 -> 0d328303 (fz-5xp.30) -> 6ee0b86 (fz-kdt.22) -> b9d1630 (fz-tfn.67)`. The intended live base is PR #151 (`fz-6lf.4`), whose tip has passed CI. The uncommitted fz-tfn.62 candidate remains frozen in its own worktree and is not part of this ticket.

## Correct model

One ticket has one commit and one reviewable PR. Rebuild the remote stack on the current fz-lib tip as `fz-5xp.30 -> fz-kdt.22 -> fz-tfn.67`, with one draft PR per branch and each title/body accurately explaining that ticket alone. #148 becomes the .30 PR (or is replaced by an equivalent .30-only draft if GitHub cannot safely preserve it); `.22` and `.67` receive their own stacked drafts. `gh stack` is the sole stack authority after the move.

The retired #129 relation must not survive in the new stack. Close obsolete draft PRs and delete their remote branches only after every descendant has been relinked, every retained commit is reachable from its intended PR, and the replacement stack is visible in `gh stack`. Do not rewrite main, delete a worktree, or lose the frozen .62 candidate.

## Acceptance

- Record the old and new commit/PR graph before mutation; prove every retained commit remains reachable after it.
- Rebase/replay only the three completed ticket commits onto #151, resolving conflicts semantically and running proportionate validation.
- Create or repair exactly three draft PRs, one per ticket, with truthful titles and ELI5 descriptions; link them with `gh stack` bottom-to-top.
- #148 no longer contains `.22` or `.67`; no PR silently carries another ticket.
- The old #129 stack relation is gone; obsolete PRs/branches with no retained value are closed/deleted only after the replacement graph is verified.
- `gh stack` topology, `git merge-base`, PR commit lists, clean worktrees, diff checks, and CI state are recorded.
- No source implementation changes, temporary compatibility commits, or hidden force-push fallout remain.

## Causality

This ticket blocks the reopened fz-5xp.30 contract cutover. That cutover blocks fz-tfn.62 and therefore the dependent tfn chain.

## Review

A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review must check graph membership, PR boundaries, branch bases, and that no frozen worktree content was lost before close.
title: Rebuild #148 as a truthful stack before the intrinsic cutover
